reproduction.expected: A governed repair task may be interrupted at any point, but recovery must resume from durable evidence and success must be impossible until every required gate is proven.
reproduction.actual: The previous orchestrator stored progress primarily in process memory. Repeated evidence acquisition could make no progress, a fixer could be replayed after interruption, and no persisted completion guard rejected a fabricated or premature COMPLETED state.

violated_invariants: No required gate may be replaced by conversational confidence.
A mutating fixer must be at-most-once across recoverable interruption windows.
Repeated no-progress actions must switch strategy or stop as BLOCKED.
COMPLETED must be derived from durable evidence, not a model or caller decision.
